import numpy as np, collections, math
G=np.full((30,30),4,dtype=int)
G[:9,6]=3; G[8,:7]=3
G[:23,21]=3
G[13,14:22]=3; G[13:23,14]=3
G[22,:]=3
markers={(6,4):1,(7,5):8,(14,15):1,(15,16):9,(19,11):1,(20,12):8,(21,13):6,(19,24):6,(20,23):5,(21,22):1,(23,20):7,(23,29):6,(24,19):2,(24,28):5,(25,18):6}
for p,v in markers.items(): G[p]=v
# components through all not wall3 using 4-neighbor
H,W=G.shape
lab=np.full((H,W),-1,int); comps=[]
for r in range(H):
 for c in range(W):
  if G[r,c]==3 or lab[r,c]>=0: continue
  k=len(comps); stack=[(r,c)]; lab[r,c]=k; cells=[]
  while stack:
   x,y=stack.pop(); cells.append((x,y))
   for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
    a,b=x+dx,y+dy
    if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W and G[a,b]!=3 and lab[a,b]<0: lab[a,b]=k;stack.append((a,b))
  comps.append(cells)
for k,cells in enumerate(comps):
 rs=[p[0] for p in cells];cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
 ms=[(p,G[p]) for p in markers if lab[p]==k]
 print(k,len(cells),(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)),ms)
